scripts.test: bun run test:automation && bun run test:ai-integration && bun run test:backend && bun run test:frontend-sync && bun run test:store && bun run typecheck && bun run test:mobile
scripts.test:backend: bun test backend/test/snapshot.test.ts && AUTUMN_DISABLED=true bun --env-file=.env.local test backend/test/sync.test.ts backend/test/syncHistory.test.ts backend/test/billing.test.ts
scripts.test:frontend-sync: bun test frontend/src/sync/sync.test.ts frontend/src/sync/flush.test.ts frontend/src/sync/pull.test.ts frontend/src/sync/reconciliation.test.ts frontend/src/sync/thoughtPresentation.test.ts frontend/src/sync/canvasPresentation.test.ts
scripts.test:mobile: bun test --preload fake-indexeddb/auto frontend/src/startup/workspaceBootRetry.test.ts frontend/src/auth/reauthSignal.test.ts frontend/src/sync/accountPartition.test.ts frontend/src/sync/statusPresentation.test.ts frontend/src/layout/mobileBundles.test.ts frontend/src/preferences/devicePreferences.test.ts frontend/src/pwa/installPrompt.test.ts frontend/src/pwa/serviceWorker.test.ts frontend/src/utils/crossCanvasTabHover.test.ts frontend/src/utils/historyFeed.test.ts frontend/src/utils/mobileGestureSelection.test.ts frontend/src/utils/mobileSwipeDismiss.test.ts frontend/src/utils/mobileTileGesture.test.ts frontend/src/utils/mobileThoughtOrder.test.ts frontend/src/utils/mobileThoughtEditing.test.ts frontend/src/utils/physicalKeyboard.test.ts frontend/src/utils/pointerRect.test.ts frontend/src/utils/targetDoubleTap.test.ts frontend/src/utils/textSelection.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd frontend tsc --project ../backend/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run --cwd frontend tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun run --cwd frontend build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta 'bun run backend/index.ts' 'bun run --cwd frontend dev'
scripts.test:ai-integration: bun test backend/test/openrouter.test.ts frontend/src/utils/audioRecording.test.ts && bun test backend/test/aiProcessing.test.ts
